name: Cupertino Youth Activity Board (YAB)
org: City of Cupertino, Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Join a group of 13 middle and high school students who plan and run events for Cupertino youth, working with city recreation staff and the Teen Commission.
who_can_apply: Students in 8th to 11th grade for the upcoming school year. Anyone eligible may apply, but Cupertino residents get preference.
duration: One school-year term (for example, the 2027-28 term).
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 term closed Sunday, May 3, 2026. The page says applications for the 2027-28 term open in March 2027.
how_to_apply: Answer four short questions (300 words max each), send one non-family recommendation letter on letterhead to robertk@cupertino.gov, and share a one-minute private or unlisted YouTube 'About Me' video. Late materials are not accepted.
notes: Past events include Hack Cupertino, Pizza and Politics, a Teen Speaker Series, and the Cupertino Spelling Bee. Members plan an event about every other month. The 2027 closing date is not posted; last year it closed in early May.
